sources.entry: ClyoCloud - A personal, self-hosted cloud storage and media management application built for privacy, efficiency, and aesthetics. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs

summary.name: ClyoCloud
summary.one_liner: A self-hosted personal cloud storage and media management app for storing, organizing, streaming, and sharing files from your own hardware.
use_cases: host personal files on your own hardware
stream videos from your own server
share files via public links without account access
organize and tag photos and media
sync wallpapers to an Android phone
replace a mainstream cloud storage provider
summary.what_it_does: ClyoCloud is a Node.js web application for storing and managing files on your own server. It offers folder creation, drag-and-drop uploads, context-menu actions, bulk delete and download, and on-the-fly zipping. Videos stream with range-aware playback that supports scrubbing, and ffmpeg generates thumbnails and previews. Metadata such as tags, descriptions, favorites, and activity logs is kept in .cloudinfo sidecar files next to each item instead of a database. Access is protected by TOTP two-factor authentication and JWT-guarded API routes, and public links can share individual files.
notable: Metadata stored in sidecar .cloudinfo JSON files, so no database engine is needed
Quick login via QR code registers revocable device tokens valid for 365 days
Companion Android apps: ClyoCloud Android client and ClyoWallpaper
caveats: Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe installed for thumbnail and preview generation
Requires manual setup via npm, Node.js, and a .env file; no Docker or packaged installer is mentioned
Page does not describe a stable release status or ongoing maintenance
